blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 工具在 CCS 變更中的應用：
blocks.en: Applying ICH Q12 tools to CCS changes:

blocks.zh: Established Conditions (ECs, 既定條件)：ICH Q12 中定義的、對產品品質有直接影響且需要法規通報的製程條件。明確區分 EC 與非 EC，有助於集中資源管理真正關鍵的變更。
blocks.en: Established Conditions (ECs): As defined in ICH Q12, the process conditions that directly affect product quality and require regulatory reporting. Clearly distinguishing ECs from non-ECs helps focus resources on the changes that are truly critical.

blocks.zh: PACMPs (Post-Approval Change Management Protocols, 核准後變更管理計畫書)：預先核准的變更計畫，定義了未來變更的評估方法和接受標準。與 Comparability Protocol (CP) 概念相似，但更廣泛。
blocks.en: PACMPs (Post-Approval Change Management Protocols): Pre-approved change plans that define the assessment methods and acceptance criteria for future changes. Similar in concept to the Comparability Protocol (CP) but broader.

blocks.zh: Drug Shortage 觸發加速審查：如果產品面臨或可能面臨藥品短缺 (drug shortage)，FDA 會考慮加速審查 supplement 或接受更低的通報類別。這是一個重要的策略杠桿——CDMO 的客戶在論證降低通報類別時，可以將供應鏈風險和潛在短缺作為論據之一。
blocks.en: Drug shortage triggers expedited review: If a product is facing or may face a drug shortage, FDA will consider expediting review of the supplement or accepting a lower reporting category. This is an important strategic lever: when a CDMO's client argues for a lower reporting category, supply chain risk and potential shortage can be used as one of the arguments.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: Risk-based 通報類別降級就像信用卡額度調整：銀行（FDA）根據你的信用歷史（body of knowledge + risk assessment）決定你的信用額度（通報類別的嚴格程度）。如果你一直按時還款、信用紀錄良好（有完善的品質系統、豐富的產品知識、充分的風險評估），銀行可能願意給你更高的額度（更低的通報類別）。但你必須先與銀行溝通（contact FDA for feedback and concurrence），不能自行決定降級。
blocks.en: Downgrading a reporting category on a risk basis is like adjusting a credit card limit: the bank (FDA) decides your credit limit (the strictness of the reporting category) based on your credit history (body of knowledge plus risk assessment). If you have always repaid on time and have a good record (a sound quality system, extensive product knowledge, and thorough risk assessment), the bank may be willing to give you a higher limit (a lower reporting category). But you must talk to the bank first (contact FDA for feedback and concurrence); you cannot decide on a downgrade yourself.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: "Contact FDA first" 的強制性：FDA 明確要求，在提交低於法規要求/指引建議的通報類別之前，必須先聯繫 FDA 取得反饋和同意 (feedback and concurrence)。這不是可選步驟——未經 FDA 同意就提交較低類別的 supplement，可能導致拒絕受理 (refuse to file) 或要求重新提交。
blocks.en: "Contact FDA first" is mandatory: FDA explicitly requires that, before submitting a reporting category lower than the regulation requires or the guidance recommends, you must first contact FDA to obtain feedback and concurrence. This is not an optional step: submitting a lower-category supplement without FDA's concurrence may lead to a refuse-to-file decision or a request to resubmit.

blocks.zh: CDER vs CBER 的聯繫管道：
blocks.en: Contact channels for CDER vs CBER:

blocks.zh: CDER 產品：聯繫 Regulatory Project Manager (RPM) 或 Regulatory Business Process Manager
blocks.en: CDER products: contact the Regulatory Project Manager (RPM) or the Regulatory Business Process Manager

blocks.zh: CBER 產品：聯繫相關的 CBER review office
blocks.en: CBER products: contact the relevant CBER review office

blocks.zh: 藥品短缺：額外抄送 drugshortages@fda.hhs.gov（CDER）或 cbershortage@fda.hhs.gov（CBER）
blocks.en: Drug shortages: additionally copy drugshortages@fda.hhs.gov (CDER) or cbershortage@fda.hhs.gov (CBER)

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略 — 利用 ICH Q12 降低通報負擔：
blocks.en: CDMO strategy: using ICH Q12 to reduce reporting burden:

blocks.zh: 假設你的 CDMO 為多個客戶充填同一規格的 2R 玻璃瓶。如果你需要切換到新的玻璃瓶供應商（例如從 Schott 切換到 Nipro），以下是利用 ICH Q12 工具的策略：
blocks.en: Suppose your CDMO fills the same 2R glass vial specification for several clients. If you need to switch to a new glass vial supplier (for example, from Schott to Nipro), the strategy for using ICH Q12 tools is as follows:

blocks.zh: 建立 Established Conditions：明確定義哪些玻璃瓶特性是 EC（如 composition、dimensions、surface treatment），哪些不是（如 packaging configuration）
blocks.en: Establish Established Conditions: Clearly define which vial attributes are ECs (such as composition, dimensions, and surface treatment) and which are not (such as packaging configuration)

blocks.zh: 準備 Risk Assessment：使用 ICH Q9(R1) 工具（如 FMEA）評估供應商切換的風險
blocks.en: Prepare a risk assessment: Use ICH Q9(R1) tools (such as FMEA) to assess the risk of the supplier switch

blocks.zh: 聯繫 FDA：向 RPM 提出降低通報類別的提案，附上風險評估和緩解策略
blocks.en: Contact FDA: Submit a proposal to the RPM for a lower reporting category, with the risk assessment and mitigation strategy attached

blocks.zh: 如有藥品短缺風險：同步通知 Drug Shortage Program，爭取加速審查
blocks.en: If there is a drug shortage risk: Notify the Drug Shortage Program at the same time to seek expedited review

blocks.zh: 這個策略特別適用於 dual sourcing 場景——預先建立好框架，未來供應商切換可以更快速實施。
blocks.en: This strategy is especially suited to dual sourcing scenarios: once the framework is set up in advance, future supplier switches can be implemented faster.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 的 Established Conditions (ECs) 概念如何幫助 CDMO 在 CCS 變更管理中更有效率？試以玻璃瓶的 5 個特性為例，區分哪些是 EC、哪些不是。
blocks.en: How does the Established Conditions (ECs) concept of ICH Q12 help a CDMO manage CCS changes more efficiently? Using 5 attributes of a glass vial as examples, distinguish which are ECs and which are not.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 在這份 Guidance 中特別提到 drug shortage 情境？這反映了 2020-2024 年間哪些供應鏈問題？
blocks.en: Why does FDA specifically mention drug shortage situations in this guidance? What supply chain problems of 2020-2024 does this reflect?

blocks.zh: 如果 CDMO 的客戶自行決定以 CBE-30 而非 PAS 提交某個 CCS 變更（未先徵詢 FDA），可能面臨什麼後果？
blocks.en: If a CDMO's client decides on its own to submit a CCS change as a CBE-30 rather than a PAS (without first consulting FDA), what consequences might it face?

blocks.zh: IV.B Comparability Protocols 比較性協議書
blocks.en: IV.B Comparability Protocols

blocks.zh: Comparability Protocol (CP, 比較性協議書)：CP 是一份預先撰寫的、經 FDA 核准的計畫書，描述未來 CCS 變更時將如何評估、測試和判定變更可接受。CP 的核心價值在於「先核准計畫，後快速執行」。
blocks.en: Comparability Protocol (CP): A CP is a pre-written, FDA-approved protocol that describes how a future CCS change will be assessed and tested, and how it will be judged acceptable. The core value of a CP is "approve the plan first, implement quickly later".

blocks.zh: CP 的三個關鍵特性：
blocks.en: Three key features of a CP:

blocks.zh: 一次性或可重複使用：CP 可以設計為單次變更（如從供應商 A 切換到供應商 B），也可以設計為可反覆使用（如「未來任何玻璃瓶供應商切換均適用本 CP」）
blocks.en: Single-use or reusable: A CP can be designed for a single change (such as switching from supplier A to supplier B) or for repeated use (such as "this CP applies to any future glass vial supplier switch")

blocks.zh: 跨產品適用：CP 可以覆蓋共享同一 CCS 組件的多個產品，透過 grouped supplements 或 trans-BLA submissions 實現
blocks.en: Applicable across products: A CP can cover multiple products that share the same CCS component, through grouped supplements or trans-BLA submissions

blocks.zh: 降低通報類別：一旦 CP 被核准，原本需要 PAS 的變更可以降級為 CBE-30 實施
blocks.en: Lower reporting category: Once a CP is approved, a change that would otherwise require a PAS can be implemented as a CBE-30

blocks.zh: Grouped Supplements / Trans-BLA Submissions：當一個 CCS 變更影響多個 NDA/BLA 產品時，可以用 grouped supplement 同時覆蓋多個申請。這大幅降低了法規提交的重複工作。
blocks.en: Grouped Supplements / Trans-BLA Submissions: When a CCS change affects multiple NDA/BLA products, a grouped supplement can cover several applications at once. This greatly reduces duplicated regulatory submission work.

blocks.zh: Comparability Protocol 就像預先核准的旅行清單 (pre-approved travel checklist)。假設你是國際業務人員，每次出差都需要公司批准。你可以和主管（FDA）事先制定一份通用出差計畫：定義出差條件、費用上限、報告格式。主管核准後，未來每次符合條件的出差，你只需填寫清單、附上證明，就可以快速出發，不需要每次都重新申請完整的出差審批。
blocks.en: A Comparability Protocol is like a pre-approved travel checklist. Suppose you are an international sales representative and every business trip needs company approval. You can agree a general travel plan with your manager (FDA) in advance: defining the trip conditions, expense limits, and reporting format. Once the manager approves it, for each future trip that meets the conditions you only need to fill in the checklist and attach proof, and you can leave quickly, without applying for full trip approval each time.

blocks.zh: 對 CCS 變更來說：你預先定義了「什麼樣的供應商切換是可接受的」「需要做哪些測試」「判定標準是什麼」，FDA 核准後，未來每次供應商切換只需按照 CP 執行，提交 CBE-30 而非 PAS。
blocks.en: For a CCS change: you define in advance "what kind of supplier switch is acceptable", "what tests are needed", and "what the acceptance criteria are". After FDA approves, each future supplier switch only needs to follow the CP and be submitted as a CBE-30 rather than a PAS.

blocks.zh: CP 是 CDMO 最強大的法規工具之一：
blocks.en: The CP is one of the most powerful regulatory tools for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: FDA 在本 Guidance 中明確指出 CP 特別適合 CCS 變更，原因是：
blocks.en: FDA states explicitly in this guidance that a CP is particularly well suited to CCS changes, for these reasons:

blocks.zh: 一對多 (One-to-Many)：一個玻璃瓶變更可能影響使用同一瓶型的所有產品。CP 可以一次覆蓋所有產品。
blocks.en: One-to-many: A glass vial change may affect all products that use the same vial type. A CP can cover all of them at once.

blocks.zh: 供應鏈動態性 (Dynamic Supply Chain)：玻璃瓶供應商的廠址變更、製程升級是持續發生的。可重複使用的 CP 讓每次變更都能快速實施。
blocks.en: Dynamic supply chain: Glass vial suppliers continually change sites and upgrade processes. A reusable CP lets each change be implemented quickly.

blocks.zh: 時間效益：PAS 的審查時間可能需要 6-12 個月。透過 CP，變更可以降級為 CBE-30（30 天），或甚至 Annual Report。
blocks.en: Time benefit: PAS review can take 6-12 months. With a CP, the change can be downgraded to a CBE-30 (30 days) or even an Annual Report.

blocks.zh: 與 ICH Q12 PACMP 的關係：CP 是 FDA 的具體機制，PACMP 是 ICH Q12 的概念性框架。二者目標一致——透過預先計畫降低核准後變更的法規負擔。FDA 在其 ICH Q12 實施指引中說明了兩者的對應關係。
blocks.en: Relationship to the ICH Q12 PACMP: The CP is FDA's specific mechanism, and the PACMP is the conceptual framework of ICH Q12. Their goal is the same: to reduce the regulatory burden of post-approval changes through advance planning. FDA explains how the two correspond in its ICH Q12 implementation guidance.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 CP 投資回報分析
blocks.en: Formulas and Calculations: CP Return-on-Investment Analysis

blocks.zh:
CP 開發成本 ≈ 50-100 萬台幣（撰寫 + 內部審查 + FDA 提交）
PAS 每次提交成本 ≈ 30-50 萬台幣（數據準備 + 審查費 + 等待成本）
PAS 審查等待時間 ≈ 6-12 個月（期間可能無法使用新供應商）

假設 CP 覆蓋 5 個產品、未來 5 年 3 次供應商變更：
  不使用 CP：5 產品 × 3 次 × 40 萬 = 600 萬台幣（PAS 成本）
  使用 CP：100 萬（CP 開發）+ 5 × 3 × 5 萬（CBE-30 成本）= 175 萬台幣

節省：600 - 175 = 425 萬台幣
時間節省：每次變更從 6-12 月縮短至 30 天
blocks.en:
CP development cost ≈ NT$500,000-1,000,000 (drafting + internal review + FDA submission)
Cost per PAS submission ≈ NT$300,000-500,000 (data preparation + review fees + cost of waiting)
PAS review waiting time ≈ 6-12 months (the new supplier may not be usable during this period)

Assume the CP covers 5 products and 3 supplier changes over the next 5 years:
  Without a CP: 5 products × 3 changes × NT$400,000 = NT$6,000,000 (PAS cost)
  With a CP: NT$1,000,000 (CP development) + 5 × 3 × NT$50,000 (CBE-30 cost) = NT$1,750,000

Savings: 6,000,000 - 1,750,000 = NT$4,250,000
Time saved: each change shortened from 6-12 months to 30 days

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 CP 策略規劃：
blocks.en: CP strategy planning for CDMOs:

blocks.zh: 作為臨床期 CDMO，建議客戶在以下時機啟動 CP 規劃：
blocks.en: As a clinical-stage CDMO, we recommend that clients start CP planning at the following points:

blocks.zh: NDA/BLA 提交階段：在原始申請中包含 CP，這是最理想的時機——FDA 審查申請時一併核准 CP，無需額外提交 PAS
blocks.en: At NDA/BLA submission: Include the CP in the original application. This is the ideal time: FDA approves the CP together with the application, so no additional PAS is needed

blocks.zh: 商業化初期：當產品開始商業生產後，預見到供應鏈需求（如 dual sourcing），提交含 CP 的 PAS
blocks.en: Early commercialization: Once the product enters commercial production and supply chain needs are foreseen (such as dual sourcing), submit a PAS that includes a CP

blocks.zh: 供應鏈危機前：不要等到供應商出問題才行動。主動建立 CP 是供應鏈韌性 (supply chain resilience) 策略的一部分
blocks.en: Before a supply chain crisis: Do not wait until a supplier has a problem. Proactively establishing a CP is part of a supply chain resilience strategy

blocks.zh: CP 內容建議（for CCS 變更）：
blocks.en: Suggested CP content (for CCS changes):

blocks.zh: 定義變更範圍：哪些類型的 CCS 變更由本 CP 覆蓋
blocks.en: Define the scope of change: which types of CCS change the CP covers

blocks.zh: 測試計畫：CCIT、extractables/leachables、穩定性研究的規格和方法
blocks.en: Test plan: specifications and methods for CCIT, extractables/leachables, and stability studies

blocks.zh: 判定標準：什麼條件下變更可接受
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria: the conditions under which a change is acceptable

blocks.zh: 通報類別論證：為什麼降級是合理的
blocks.en: Justification of the reporting category: why the downgrade is reasonable

blocks.zh: 適用的產品清單（grouped supplements）
blocks.en: List of applicable products (grouped supplements)

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 特別指出 CP 「well-suited」 for glass vial and stopper changes？相較於其他 CMC 變更（如配方變更、製程變更），CCS 變更有什麼特殊性使 CP 特別有效？
blocks.en: Why does FDA specifically say that a CP is "well-suited" for glass vial and stopper changes? Compared with other CMC changes (such as formulation or process changes), what is special about CCS changes that makes a CP particularly effective?

blocks.zh: 設計一個 Comparability Protocol 的框架，覆蓋「Type I 玻璃瓶供應商切換」的場景。需要定義哪些測試項目和判定標準？
blocks.en: Design a framework for a Comparability Protocol that covers the scenario of "switching the Type I glass vial supplier". Which test items and acceptance criteria need to be defined?

blocks.zh: Grouped supplements 和 trans-BLA submissions 在實務上如何運作？如果一家公司有 10 個 BLA 產品使用同一規格的 20mm stopper，如何利用 CP + grouped supplement 最有效率地管理供應商切換？
blocks.en: How do grouped supplements and trans-BLA submissions work in practice? If a company has 10 BLA products that use the same 20 mm stopper specification, how can a CP plus a grouped supplement be used to manage supplier switches most efficiently?

blocks.zh: References 參考文獻
blocks.en: References

blocks.zh: 這份 References 清單就像一棟大樓的建築圖集。本 2024 年 Guidance 是「室內裝修指南」（專門處理 CCS 變更），但它引用了：結構圖（1999 CCS Guidance）、水電圖（SUPAC 系列）、消防圖（ICH Q9 風險管理）、物業管理規約（ICH Q10 品質系統）。你不可能只看裝修指南就完成工程——必須交叉參考所有圖紙。
blocks.en: This list of references is like the set of architectural drawings for a building. This 2024 guidance is the "interior renovation guide" (dealing specifically with CCS changes), but it cites the structural drawings (the 1999 CCS Guidance), the plumbing and electrical drawings (the SUPAC series), the fire safety drawings (ICH Q9 risk management), and the property management rules (the ICH Q10 quality system). You cannot complete the project with the renovation guide alone; you must cross-reference all the drawings.

blocks.zh: CDMO 必備的三份核心文件：
blocks.en: Three core documents every CDMO needs:

blocks.zh: Container Closure Systems for Packaging Human Drugs and Biologics (1999)：雖然已超過 25 年，仍是 FDA 評估 CCS 的基石。定義了 protection、safety、compatibility、performance 四大評估面向。
blocks.en: Container Closure Systems for Packaging Human Drugs and Biologics (1999): Although more than 25 years old, it remains the cornerstone of FDA's CCS assessment. It defines the four assessment dimensions of protection, safety, compatibility, and performance.

blocks.zh: Comparability Protocols (2022)：CP 的詳細撰寫和提交指引。是 Section IV.B 的完整參考。
blocks.en: Comparability Protocols (2022): Detailed guidance on drafting and submitting a CP. The complete reference for Section IV.B.

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 + FDA Implementation (2021)：Established Conditions 和 PACMP 的概念和實施細節。
blocks.en: ICH Q12 + FDA Implementation (2021): The concepts and implementation details of Established Conditions and PACMPs.

blocks.zh: 與 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 的連結：雖然 References 中未列出 PIC/S Annex 1，但 Annex 1 的 Section 8 (Container Closure Integrity) 和 Section 4 (Contamination Control Strategy) 與本 Guidance 高度相關。PIC/S Annex 1 要求 CCS 變更必須納入 Contamination Control Strategy，這與 FDA 的 risk-based approach 一致。
blocks.en: Link to PIC/S Annex 1 (2022): Although PIC/S Annex 1 is not listed in the References, Section 8 (Container Closure Integrity) and Section 4 (Contamination Control Strategy) of Annex 1 are highly relevant to this guidance. PIC/S Annex 1 requires CCS changes to be incorporated into the Contamination Control Strategy, which is consistent with FDA's risk-based approach.

blocks.zh: 如果你需要為客戶的 BLA 產品評估一個 stopper 供應商變更，你會依序查閱 References 中的哪些文件？為什麼？
blocks.en: If you need to assess a stopper supplier change for a client's BLA product, which documents in the References would you consult, and in what order? Why?

blocks.zh: 1999 年的 CCS Guidance 和 2024 年的 Glass Vial Guidance 最大的差異是什麼？2024 年版增加了哪些 1999 年版沒有的概念？
blocks.en: What is the biggest difference between the 1999 CCS Guidance and the 2024 Glass Vial Guidance? What concepts does the 2024 version add that the 1999 version lacked?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 參考文獻地圖
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Reference Map

blocks.zh: 理解 FDA CCS 變更的法規生態系統：本 Guidance 的 References 列出的不是「延伸閱讀」，而是構成 CCS 變更法規框架的核心文件。理解它們之間的關係至關重要：
blocks.en: Understanding the regulatory ecosystem for FDA CCS changes: The References of this guidance are not "further reading" but the core documents that make up the regulatory framework for CCS changes. Understanding how they relate to each other is essential:

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Risk-Based 降級機制：FDA 可根據申請者的風險評估和緩解策略，同意降低 CCS 變更的通報類別，但申請者必須事先聯繫 FDA 取得同意
blocks.en: Risk-based downgrade mechanism: FDA may agree to a lower reporting category for a CCS change based on the applicant's risk assessment and mitigation strategy, but the applicant must contact FDA beforehand to obtain concurrence

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 是關鍵工具：Established Conditions 和 PACMPs 提供了系統性降低法規負擔的框架
blocks.en: ICH Q12 is a key tool: Established Conditions and PACMPs provide a systematic framework for reducing regulatory burden

blocks.zh: Drug Shortage 加速通道：藥品短缺情境可觸發 FDA 的加速審查或通報類別降級
blocks.en: Drug shortage fast track: A drug shortage situation can trigger FDA expedited review or a downgrade of the reporting category

blocks.zh: Comparability Protocol 是最強工具：CP 允許預先核准變更計畫，未來實施變更時可降級為 CBE-30，可一次性或重複使用，可覆蓋多個產品
blocks.en: The Comparability Protocol is the most powerful tool: A CP allows a change plan to be approved in advance, so future changes can be implemented as a CBE-30; it can be single-use or reusable and can cover multiple products

blocks.zh: CP 特別適合 CCS 變更：因為同一玻璃瓶/瓶塞供應商變更通常影響多個產品，且供應鏈變更是持續發生的
blocks.en: A CP is especially suited to CCS changes: Because a change of glass vial/stopper supplier usually affects multiple products, and supply chain changes occur continually

blocks.zh: 法規生態系統的交叉引用：本 Guidance 建立在 1999 CCS Guidance、SUPAC 系列、ICH Q9/Q10/Q12 等核心文件之上，不能孤立閱讀
blocks.en: Cross-references in the regulatory ecosystem: This guidance builds on core documents such as the 1999 CCS Guidance, the SUPAC series, and ICH Q9/Q10/Q12, and cannot be read in isolation
